C reaches VERIFIED (test ran, verification passed) while the page stays open
E asks permission before its test step
E TESTING is derived from the terminal.exec test command
agent.pause accepted by the Host
checks.detail: A finished agent cannot be paused.

checks.name: E shows PAUSED from Host AgentState PAUSED
H (background runner) waits for permission before the UI is closed
wait: H COMPLETED with UI closed
with the UI closed the Host keeps the Mission running to completion
denied delete ends the Agent FAILED (Host AgentState FAILED)
F (delete ask) waits for the user
stopped Agent shows STOPPED from Host AgentState
G (failing verification) settles at a Host-recorded state
